title: Choose the whole project or a recent story from the bookmark

intentCoverage.report:
## Intent Coverage — SEED-420#choose-review-scope

**Verdict. Caught.** At revision `37c514fe1073a605828fcb8178b42b0d55271843`, the maintained browser test catches the previous Changes tab surviving when the same remembered story is reselected after **Whole project**.

**Evidence.** The story promises that reselecting starts the default view and comparison. In a detached scratch checkout, I changed only `dashboard/src/pageStorySelection.tsx:84` from `setSelected({ ...story })` to `setSelected(story)`, reusing the history entry as the selection object. The unchanged mounted Chromium fixture starts in a story diff, chooses **Whole project**, and reopens `SEED-219#failing` from Open Dough’s recent stories. The trace records that recent-row click, the menu closing, and the story and Intent perspective assertions passing. The failure screenshot independently shows **Changes** still underlined with the selected file’s diff panel displayed. The maintained test “Whole project opens trunk CI from a story diff and a recent starts its default comparison” failed at `dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-home-activation-scope.spec.ts:214` because **CI comparison** had `aria-selected="false"`. The exact command, `caffeinate -s -i node scripts/test-frontend.mjs dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-home-activation-scope.spec.ts`, passed five of five at baseline, produced that one failure with four passes under the fault, and passed five of five after restoration. The restored scratch matched its initial clean Git state at the same revision and was removed. The evidence directory retains `baseline.log`, `fault.log`, `restored.log`, `injected-fault.diff`, and the browser result and screenshot. [Evidence directory](/tmp/open-dough-scope-coverage.3sYVVFdy)

**Next proof action.** Retain the existing test for this transition. The result confirms the already-delivered fresh selection fix and supplies no new repair for the observed path.

- **Test runtime.** 39.39 seconds (measured), the sum of the runner-reported baseline, fault, and restored durations of 8.78, 21.82, and 8.79 seconds.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate human time measurement was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No agent effort measurement separated active work from setup and test waits.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 116267 ms (measured), from 1795608752773 to 1795608869040 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition. Revision 37c514fe1073a605828fcb8178b42b0d55271843. Caught. Retain the maintained transition assertion. No follow-up.
